content_of_post_to_comment:
Saturday night, I'm at home because nobody seems to be bothered in going out or hanging out anymore, only 10 years ago this would have been really rare. I can't pintpoint the exact moment everything changed but its clear to see everything has changed and I just can't see me living in this ''new'' world. I just don't have it in me, I'm not built like that. The way we replaced socialization with screens it's slowly killing me. The advices I get like ''go and do things yourself'' are worthless because the thing is, I don't want to do things myself, I want to share experiences with other people, same as ''look for another group of friends''. I moved cities because of this, I live in one of the most social countires on earth and it's just a general problem PEOPLE JUST DON'T WANT TO DO NOTHING but scroll all day, whenever I finally get somebody to meet you can tell they are addicted, most of the time they expect you to make up a plan that feels better than the dopamine they can easily get at home, some of them can't listen for more than 10 minutes without distraction or the topics are surface level because they are not used to think about something that is not hedonistic endless distractions. People have become flaky as hell and are not able to recognize there is a human being with feelings on the other side of the screen, they just don't care. Third spaces are dying, every space we have for the youth here in my city has been closed after COVID, it's like an intentional push towards a digital life. It's done in purpose. Arts and humanities, culture at large, dead and gone. What do we have instead? Chat GPT and reels? Does that satisfy the human soul?

As much as I try to go outside it seems like the outside world, the real world, is empty. I tried to go offline but I just feel the same level of alienation. I've been on the Internet since 2008, this is not funny no more, they sucked the fun out of it, I'm sick of it, there is nothing for me there but I'm kinda pushed to be here because ''everything'' seems to be here anyways. I've been coping with this for 6 years now and I don't know how much am I going to be able to cope if things don't change.

After going thru a near death experience I just can't unsee the fact that time on this earth is limited, I can't understand how people are choosing to spend it in meaningless distractions and screens, I'm sick only with the thought of how much time I've wasted online. I'm honestly hopeless, so I'm posting here to see if somebody else has this feeling and to see how people deal with this. Is there any hope?
